content:
Parameter
Required?
Description
valid_secs
Optional
The number of seconds this activation code
remains valid. Default: 86400  (one day).
install
Optional
Specify 1  to cause an installation SMS
message to be sent before the activation
message, or 0  to not send an installation
SMS message. Default: 0 .
installation_msg
Optional
A custom installation message to send to the
user. Only valid if installation was requested.
Must contain the phrase "<insturl>", which is
replaced with the installation URL.
activation_msg
Optional
A custom activation message to send to the
user. Must contain "<acturl>", which is
replaced with the activation URL.
